baseline_models.focus_anchor: The denial of سُلْطَان is followed by لِنَعْلَمَ, the contrast between يُؤْمِنُ and فِي شَكّ, and the closure حَفِيظ.
baseline_models.mechanism: With coercive force absent, exposure to influence can disclose rather than manufacture the heart's stance: settled trust and interpenetrated uncertainty separate while the Lord guards the whole field.

activation_trace.role: The denied branch contributes overpowering force, whose absence makes the resulting distinction non-compelled.
Knowing as disclosure supplies the manifesting function of the purpose clause.
Heart-settled assent supplies the stable pole disclosed by the test.
Two possibilities interpenetrating without settled certainty supply the opposed pole.
Comprehensive guarding keeps the disclosure within divine oversight rather than the denied possessor's control.

changed_reading.before: The one referred to by له lacks authority, and the episode merely identifies two already named groups.
changed_reading.after: The denied coercion is what makes the episode diagnostic: influence exposes settled trust or internally entangled doubt without creating either by force, under comprehensive guardianship.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: سُلْطَان can name a compelling proof as well as force, while يُؤْمِنُ and شَكّ describe opposed epistemic postures.
baseline_models.mechanism: The denied possessor has no self-authenticating evidence. A claim without compelling proof gains traction only where a hearer's uncertainty admits it, whereas settled assent does not derive from that claim.

activation_trace.role: The compelling-proof image makes the denial epistemic rather than only political.
Assent that rests in the heart supplies a response not compelled by the denied proof.
Interpenetrating alternatives explain where a proofless solicitation can remain live.
Disclosure turns the hearer's response into what becomes knowable.

changed_reading.before: سُلْطَان denotes only political or coercive power over the people.
changed_reading.after: It can also deny evidentiary force: the solicitation carries no proof that conquers the hearer, and its reception discloses whether the heart is settled or divided.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence links نَعْلَمَ to the exhaustive phrase كُلِّ شَىْءٍ and to حَفِيظ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge can take a marking function: the encounter leaves an identifying trace, every knowable and reportable thing falls within the total scope, and preservation makes the distinction durably legible rather than momentary.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark changes knowing from bare acquisition into manifested identifiability.
Encircled totality extends the marked distinction across the whole evidentiary field.
The knowable, reportable thing supplies the unit included in that totality.
Retention supplies the non-loss of what the encounter has made distinct.

changed_reading.before: لِنَعْلَمَ describes only the acquisition of information at the moment of testing.
changed_reading.after: The purpose can be the production of a marked and retainable distinction whose evidence remains legible within an all-inclusive preservation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Faith is specifically بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ, opposed to being in doubt مِنْهَا, before the statement of continuous preservation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The later or deferred horizon tests whether the heart can rest securely in what is not yet present. Doubt leaves present and later possibilities interpenetrating, while preservation keeps that temporal orientation in view.

activation_trace.role: Deferral to a later time supplies the unseen temporal horizon of the stance.
Security and heart-rest supply trust toward that deferred horizon.
Unsettled interpenetration supplies temporal division about that horizon.
Continuous keeping supplies persistence of the disclosed orientation through time.

changed_reading.before: The verse only labels two opinions about a future event.
changed_reading.after: It diagnoses temporal trust: whether the heart can settle around a deferred horizon or remains divided about it, with that orientation continuously kept in view.

context_deltas.mechanism: Nothing even at dispersed particle scale can go absent, small and large are entered in a clear record, and the later all-thing formula substitutes witnessing for preserving. حَفِيظ therefore supports an evidentiary ledger that can make the faith/doubt distinction accountable.

activation_trace.role: Guarding supplies the focus anchor for non-loss of the disclosed distinction.
Distance, absence, and escape are explicitly negated, making preservation exhaustive.
Minute dispersed particles set the lower scale at which nothing drops from account.
Entry into a register turns non-escape into retained, classifiable evidence.
Presence with witnessing gives the preserved all-thing field an evidentiary and accountable function.

structural_cues: 34:3 brackets smaller and larger together and locates them in a clear book.
34:47 repeats the focus construction على كل شيء but ends with شهيد.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-escape, minute scale, registration, and witnessing; I infer that حفظ preserves adjudicable evidence. A live alternative is general guardianship without a literal ledger mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Every thing is generally protected or remembered.
changed_reading.after: Every stance and act remains non-escaping, registered evidence, so the disclosed distinction can be witnessed and judged rather than merely noticed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Jinn perform consequential work by permission and can deviate, yet a material collapse reveals that they lacked hidden knowledge. This separates operational capacity from independent سُلْطَان: bounded efficacy can be real without sovereign authorization or epistemic mastery.

activation_trace.role: Power and delegated jurisdiction supply the focus category that the context differentiates from mere capacity.
Authorization makes the jinn's real labor permission-bound rather than independently sovereign.
Possible deviation from the straight course shows agency operating inside the bounded commission.
Disclosure by an indicating sign makes the later material event evidentiary.
The body's audible, unstable fall is the concrete event that breaks the appearance of mastery.
Emergence and uncovering turn the collapse into manifest differentiation.
What is hidden from sight marks the knowledge the active jinn demonstrably did not possess.

structural_cues: 34:12 locates jinn labor before Solomon within the Lord's permission and threat for deviation.
34:14 makes a creature eating the staff and the body's fall the event by which their ignorance becomes clear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies permission, deviation, effective labor, a material sign, and ignorance of the hidden; I infer a distinction between capacity and authority. The analogy remains limited because the working jinn and the focus possessor are not identical agents.

changed_reading.before: No سُلْطَان means the relevant agent can do nothing consequential at all.
changed_reading.after: An agent may exert consequential, organized influence while lacking independent authorization, coercive sovereignty, and command of the hidden; bounded efficacy is not سُلْطَان.

context_deltas.mechanism: Iblis's conjecture is verified through their following, while a separate believing group does not follow. The knowledge-purpose is therefore realization and separation of an initially conjectural social forecast through response, not proof that the forecaster possessed coercive force.

activation_trace.role: Denied overpowering force prevents the verified conjecture from being read as coerced production.
Disclosure supplies the purpose reached when responses become manifest.
Verification in deed contributes the conjecture becoming actual over its subjects.
Conjecture and uncertain imagining supply the forecast that initially lacks accomplished fact.
Following in another's track supplies the subjects' act that verifies the forecast.
A distinct group supplies the believing exception and the separation produced by response.

structural_cues: 34:20 places فَاتَّبَعُوهُ between the conjecture's verification and the exception of believers.
34:21 immediately denies Iblis's سُلْطَان and states the purpose of distinguishing responses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conjecture, its verification, following, and an excepted group; I supply the arrow that following actualizes rather than is forced by the conjecture. A live alternative is that divine permission, more than voluntary ratification, is the controlling frame.

changed_reading.before: Iblis first controls them, and their following then demonstrates his power.
changed_reading.after: His forecast becomes true only in their act of following; the test discloses who ratifies a solicitation and who remains a distinct believing group, without coercive manufacture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following denials unpack سُلْطَان into routes of binding agency: ownership and disposal, a share, backing, and intercessory joining; the only admitted mediation is permission-bound. The focus denial is therefore a structured absence of independent leverage, not merely low influence.

activation_trace.role: Power and jurisdiction provide the bundle that the following verses disaggregate.
Ownership with disposal supplies one denied route of control, even at particle scale.
Partnership supplies the denied possibility of shared title or participation.
Strength gained from a backer supplies the denied institutional support route.
An intercessor joining another supplies mediation as a possible route of effect.
Authorization bounds that mediation and prevents it from becoming independent authority.

structural_cues: 34:22 repeats ما لهم and من denials across possession, partnership, and backing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies layered denials and permission-bound mediation; I infer that they specify components of the focus سُلْطَان. The live alternative is that the focus term concerns Iblis's coercion more narrowly than the later divine-control contrast.

changed_reading.before: Iblis lacks one unspecified kind of power.
changed_reading.after: He lacks every independent route to binding agency: property control, joint title, institutional backing, and unlicensed mediation; any effect travels through response rather than sovereign leverage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The weakened and the self-exalting exchange blame: leaders deny directly turning followers from guidance, while followers name continuous plotting and commands. This distinguishes asymmetrical pressure from coercive سُلْطَان: rank can structure options and solicit wrongdoing without transferring all agency.

activation_trace.role: Denied coercive force anchors the boundary between pressure and compelled action.
Lack of strength supplies the followers' real social asymmetry.
Elevated rank and leadership supply the opposing side's structural advantage.
Turning and diverting from guidance supplies the disputed causal act.
Demand and attempted obligation supply a concrete mechanism of elite pressure short of the denied coercion.

structural_cues: 34:31-32 stages reciprocal accusation between those made weak and those seeking greatness over who blocked guidance.
34:33 names night-and-day plotting and commands to disbelieve, then shows shared regret and recompense for deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies weakness, rank, disputed diversion, commands, and consequences for deeds; I infer that pressure can be causally serious without becoming exculpating coercion. The text leaves the relative weight of each side's responsibility materially open.

changed_reading.before: No سُلْطَان means all followers faced socially equal and isolated choices.
changed_reading.after: No coercive title does not erase hierarchy or incessant command: influence can be asymmetric and culpable while the response still discloses each participant's agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: At seizure there is no missed reach; professed faith then asks how attainment can occur from a distant place, and a barrier separates people from desire after prior agitated doubt. The afterlife distinction is thus preserved through an opportunity window and is not erased by a late utterance after disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The deferred later time anchors the horizon whose arrival changes the conditions of response.
Settled assent anchors the stance whose timing the context tests.
Unsettled interpenetration anchors the prior condition preserved into the closing scene.
Failure of escape or attainment supplies the closure of ordinary reach at seizure.
Stretching out to attain something supplies the attempted late reach toward faith.
Distance from nearness supplies the gap that makes the late attainment impossible.
A separating barrier makes the temporal-spatial closure operative.
Agitated uncertainty intensifies the focus doubt as the history preceding that closure.

structural_cues: 34:51-52 moves from near-place capture to attempted attainment from a distant place.
34:54 closes with a barrier and explicitly returns to their prior doubt.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed reach, distance, a barrier, professed faith, and prior doubt; I infer that faith's efficacy depends on the stance formed before final disclosure. A live alternative is that the scene emphasizes impossibility of escape more than closure of a response window.

changed_reading.before: Any statement of faith, whenever voiced, belongs straightforwardly to the believing side.
changed_reading.after: Belief in the deferred horizon is a lived stance formed before disclosure; once the horizon is present, a late declaration cannot reach backward across the preserved history of doubt.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps civic geography onto an inner epistemic stance. It remains anchored through the focus security branch of ء م ن, doubt as interpenetration, and the immediate sequence from safe travel through chosen distance and fragmentation to following. Render it only as a social-spatial analogy, not as a replacement lexical definition of faith.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus opposes يُؤْمِنُ to interpenetrated شَكّ and closes with guarding; the same faith root appears as security immediately before distance, fragmentation, and following.

activation_trace.role: Heart-rest in security anchors faith as a capacity to inhabit trust.
Things inserted through and joined together supply a spatially exploratory image for unstable entanglement.
Guarding anchors the preservation of a connective order.
Safe travel literalizes the same root as secure inhabitation of a connected route.
Actively producing distance supplies the chosen rupture of secure proximity.
Tearing into scattered pieces supplies the social consequence of demanded distance.
Following in another's track links fragmented civic trust to susceptibility to another route.

changed_reading.before: Faith and doubt are solely interior propositions with no social-spatial mechanism.
changed_reading.after: The sequence permits a civic-topological analogy: secure connected passage figures trust, chosen remoteness yields fragmentation, and fragmented subjects become followable; faith is the guarded capacity to inhabit connection without demanding distance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads 34:46's counsel as a procedural analogue for 34:21's knowledge-purpose. It remains anchored by لِنَعْلَمَ مَن...مِمَّن, the faith/doubt distinction, and the branches of pairing, solitude, and the heart's oscillation. Render it as a diagnostic resonance, not a historical claim that 34:21 prescribes this exact procedure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus purpose marks one response off from another; 34:46 changes the social configuration of reflection between paired and solitary standing.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark anchors the focus purpose as discrimination rather than information alone.
Unsettled alternatives anchor the state that reflection may expose.
A fear-bearing reminder supplies the single diagnostic prompt.
Rising with resolve supplies active entry into the diagnostic exercise.
Joining one to one supplies paired reflection as one social condition.
The isolated individual supplies the contrasting social condition.
The heart's repeated turning over the matter supplies the internal process made visible across conditions.

changed_reading.before: The distinction is observed only in mass following or refusal.
changed_reading.after: The surah also permits a diagnostic analogue that changes social configuration: rise in pairs, then singly, and let the heart turn the matter; what persists across companionship and solitude becomes the marked faith/doubt distinction.

strongest_changes: 34:20 turns the denied سُلْطَان into non-coercive actualization: following makes a conjecture true and separates a believing group.
34:22-23 unbundles authority into ownership, partnership, backing, and permission-bound mediation.
34:3 and 34:47 recast حَفِيظ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ as preserved, witnessable evidence.
34:51-54 makes the afterlife distinction temporal: late faith cannot reach backward across a preserved history of doubt.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah field repeatedly separates efficacy from sovereignty: permission-bound labor, persuasive hierarchy, voluntary following, exhaustive recording, and delayed reach all coexist with the denial of coercive authority.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether سُلْطَان in the focus primarily denies coercive force, compelling proof, delegated authority, or deliberately carries all three.
Whether لِنَعْلَمَ is best rendered as manifestation, marking, or adjudicable realization rather than acquisition of knowledge.
How much responsibility shifts under the social asymmetry of 34:31-33; the packet shows pressure and shared recompense but does not quantify blame.
The civic-topology and paired-versus-solitary readings remain contained analogies rather than primary lexical readings.
